cases.name: Ashley Elizabeth Anderson Kittelson
cases.about: Her GoFundMe said: "shley was a devoted mother of three young children, a compassionate nurse, and a friend to so many. Anyone who knew her knew the warmth, kindness, and generosity she carried in her heart every single day. She dedicated her life to caring for others—both in her work as a nurse and in the love she poured into raising her children. Her kids were her entire world, and she worked hard to give them safety, love, and opportunity."
cases.narrative: Koochiching County Chief Sheriff’s Deputy Jonathan Froemke detailed how at 4:40 a.m. on March 6, a deputy saw Nicholas Kittelson’s vehicle outside the home and knew he was not allowed to be near his wife. The deputy got no answer when he knocked on the door, so he looked through a window and saw what appeared to be blood on a bathroom door. The deputy entered and found the Kittelsons dead behind the door.
